description.value: Fortune seems to answer your will, and you have learned to share it with those beside you. As a reaction, when an ally within 30 feet that you can see rolls a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you may spend 1 luck point to force a reroll, and the ally must use the new result. After using this ability, you cannot spend luck points again until the end of your next turn.
